text: Bitcoin's modest 1.5% decline outpaces Ethereum's 0.5% drop, signaling selective caution where traders are rotating away from the larger cap but not panicking on either major. Fear & Greed has dipped into fear territory at 37 and deteriorated over the week, though $69B in daily volume remains solid and Bitcoin dominance near 59% suggests capital hasn't fled to alts en masse. The market appears to be consolidating with underlying uncertainty rather than capitulating sharply.
